subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood Inference + Acme Cloud - next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acmecloud.com>, Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood Inference + Acme Cloud - draft & timeline options

Hi Samir/Priya,

Thanks again for the time today—good conversation and appreciate the clarity on your latency and compliance priorities.

Attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft (MAP_Draft_AcmeCloud_v1.xlsx). High-level timeline options and proposed milestones are below. Please review and confirm stakeholders so we can lock a target close date.

Proposed milestones & owners:
- Discovery complete (done) — Acme (Samir) / Redwood (Aditya)
- Security review: provide SOC2 + network diagram — Acme (security team) / Redwood (Lauren) — target complete: 2026-03-18
- Pilot agreement & access provisioning — Acme (Priya) / Redwood (Marissa) — target complete: 2026-04-01
- Pilot run & evaluation (2 weeks) — Acme (Dev/Infra) / Redwood (Lauren) — target complete: 2026-04-15
- Commercial terms & PO — Acme Procurement / Redwood Sales — target close: 2026-04-30

Dependencies & notes:
- Security questionnaire (we'll send our standard package). Redwood to provide SOC2 report and network diagram (attached).
- Pilot environment requires VPC peering or temporary credentials; we recommend peering for latency-sensitive tests.
- If SOC2 evidence is required earlier, we can loop in our compliance team this week.

Timeline options (pick one):
A) Aggressive — target close by 2026-04-15 (requires expedited security review)
B) Balanced — target close by 2026-04-30 (default)
C) Conservative — target close by 2026-05-15 (additional pilot cycles)

Ask:
1) Confirm primary stakeholders (security, infra, procurement) and point-of-contact emails.
2) Which timeline option do you prefer?
3) Any blocked dependencies we should know about (e.g., procurement window, holiday blackout)?

I'll update the MAP based on your feedback and share a Doc/Drive link. FYI I've cc'd Lauren (SE) and Marissa (CS) to handle technical onboarding and pilot coordination.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Redwood Inference + Acme Cloud - draft & timeline options

Thanks Aditya — this is great.

Quick answers:
- Stakeholders: Security (Anika Rao, anika.rao@acmecloud.com), Infra/Dev (Carlos Mendes, carlos.mendes@acmecloud.com), Procurement (Lindsay Wu, lindsay.wu@acmecloud.com).
- We prefer the Balanced timeline (target close 2026-04-30). Procurement has a monthly cutoff on 4/25 that would make aggressive timing tight.
- Security would like to see the SOC2 report and the network diagram; Anika asked if Redwood can also provide a short runbook for data handling during pilot.

One ask: can Redwood provide a list of pilot success criteria (latency P95 target, throughput, error rate, and a sample eval prompt set)? That will help our infra team scope the pilot.

Samir — joining you on next steps to make introductions to Anika/Carlos/Lindsay.

—Priya
